## Build the Future of Intelligent Commerce

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/1IjQ8toTk8MghrgCVchleprI.png?width=1452&height=974)

Malachyte is building a frontier personalization engine that adapts the internet in real- time -making every visitor feel understood from their very first click. Our founding team brings decades of deep expertise from roles at Spotify, Priceline, BCG, Google and more.

Malachyte’s journey starts with e-commerce companies who rely on their websites to help consumers discover and satisfy their intent. Our innovative solutions are a blend of advanced infrastructure, deep learning, and next-gen user experience to deliver value within weeks.

Come help us build e-commerce's real-time brain.
